title: Senior Manager, Global Direct Procurement (all genders)
description: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p>HelloFresh manages approximately €1.7B in annual direct procurement spend across ingredients and packaging, covering markets in the EU, US, Canada, ANZ, and the UK. This role builds the cost intelligence capability for Global Procurement. You will create the analytical models and frameworks that give the business clear visibility into what ingredients really cost: where those costs come from, how they move, and where the opportunities lie. Your work will give regional teams the insight they need to make well-grounded decisions and to track progress against the group's cost reduction ambitions. This is a role for a senior procurement professional who is comfortable with detailed analysis and who can explain complex numbers simply to senior leaders and to colleagues in markets. You will be recognized as the go-to expert on cost across the team.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Develop a harmonized cost measurement methodology with Finance and regional procurement teams, so that ingredient savings are defined, measured, and reported consistently across all markets.</li> <li>Build should-cost models and total cost of ownership frameworks for priority categories, breaking unit price into its drivers (origin, processing method, logistics, certification, and shelf life), and use them to identify savings and inform sourcing decisions.</li> <li>Track ingredient price drivers across markets, including contract prices, actual prices, and market inflation, and identify overlap across brands to find rationalization and consolidation opportunities.</li> <li>Report progress against the group's ingredient cost reduction target to senior leadership, explaining root causes rather than just variances, and help build the governance needed to sustain this over time.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <h2><strong>You are...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>An analytical professional who builds models that hold up to scrutiny from Finance and senior leadership.</li> <li>Commercially minded: you look at total value, not just unit price, and you understand what drives cost in food and packaging.</li> <li>A clear communicator who turns complex analysis into a simple story that regional teams can act on.</li> <li>Collaborative: you build alignment with Finance, procurement, and market teams through influence rather than authority.</li> <li>Self-directed: you manage several analyses at once and take ownership from the question through to the recommendation.</li> </ul> <p style="text-align: justify;"> </p> <h2><strong>You have...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years in procurement, cost analysis, or consulting in a global food, retail, or consumer goods business.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building should-cost models or total cost of ownership frameworks, and using them to influence real commercial decisions.</li> <li>Experience measuring cost and savings across multiple markets, including the common pitfalls such as inconsistent methods, inflation effects, and volume mix.</li> <li>Experience with food, ingredient, or packaging categories, including origin, certification, and specification considerations.</li> <li>Fluent in English. Bonus if fluent in French, German, or Dutch. Comfortable working across time zones, with the ability to travel up to 20%.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Nice to have...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Familiarity with sustainability certification schemes and their cost implications.</li> <li>Experience with commodity price risk or hedging frameworks.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>You'll get…</strong></h2> <h3><strong>If based in New York or Toronto:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary & retirement savings plan with company match</li> <li>Generous parental leave & PTO policy, plus paid holidays</li> <li>Flexible health, dental, and vision plans</li> <li>Up to 75% discount on HelloFresh subscription</li> <li>Emergency child and adult care services</li> <li>Snacks & monthly catered lunches</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>If title: Senior Security Engineer - Enterprise Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Who we are</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.</span></p></div><p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>The Senior Security Engineer – Enterprise Security shares ownership of the day-to-day operation of the Samsara security environment. You will keep our network access, device trust, and visibility systems running, tuned, and resilient at enterprise scale in partnership with a global team. Utilizing modern principles, you’ll maintain and evolve a modern zero trust program, spend time both on policy design and real-time triage for escalations.</p> <p>You take security seriously and believe the best solutions are low-friction and built in partnership with others. You are comfortable owning and maintaining production systems for long term success - troubleshooting systemic issues, tuning policies based on real incidents, and continuously improving what is already built. You bring an automation mindset to repetitive work, whether using Python, SOAR platforms, or AI-assisted tools. You enjoy supporting teammates and helping other engineers build their security knowledge.</p> <p>This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the United Kingdom. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.</p> <p><strong>About this team:</strong></p> <p>Enterprise Security is a global team spanning the US, EMEA, and India. We work in close partnership with our coworkers as collaborators rather than gatekeepers. Leadership is hands-on and technical, and our culture encourages everyone to contribute across the full stack.</p> <p>Executive leadership actively champions security as a competitive advantage that builds customer trust and helps win enterprise partnerships. You will see a direct line between the zero trust systems you operate and the security that protects our physical operations partners worldwide. Our on-call rotation for the highest severity incidents is spread evenly across the team for one week out of every ten.</p> <h4><strong>In this role, you will:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> </span></h4> <ul> <li>Co-own the day-to-day operation, triage, and tuning of the Samsara endpoint security environment by responding to escalations, investigating anomalies, and resolving issues</li> <li>Continuously improve existing endpoint visibility tools and workflows in partnership with our Security Operations team, and based on real usage patterns and incident learnings</li> <li>Write clear, concise documentation and runbooks for enterprise security workflows</li> <li>Collaborate with partners across Engineering, IT, and Security to ensure proper implementation of security tools and policies</li> <li>Assist the Security Operations team during security investigations, acting as a technical subject matter expert within your domain</li> <li>Partner with engineering teams to triage and support remediation of vulnerabilities and misconfigurations</li> <li>Mentor engineers on the Security team to grow their domain knowledge, tool-specific skills, and communication abilities</li> <li>Champion, role model, and embed Samsara cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum requirements for the role:</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant experience in an Enterprise Security role with demonstrated impact</li> <li>Hands-on experience operating and maintaining endpoint security and visibility tools at enterprise scale (e.g. Crowdstrike, osquery, or similar)</li> <li>Exposure to at least one additional enterprise security tool stack beyond endpoint security, such as Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), zero trust systems,  email security, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), or Identity and Access Management (IAM)</li> <li>An automation mindset with experience scripting and debugging code with Python (with or without AIassistance) and using SOAR platforms</li> <li>Strong familiarity with common security challenges and the ability to independently evaluate their severity and business impact</li> <li>Track record of delivering impactful work across multiple quarters and collaborating effectively across teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>An ideal candidate also has:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant breadth across the endpoint security ecosystem, including designing layered controls with EDR tools, passive telemetry, integration with threat intelligence feeds, and operation in cloud and containerized environments.</li> <li>History of building out security programs using modern SaaS security platforms such as Crowdstrike, Mimecast Incydr, and Splunk</li> <li>Experience with infrastructure as code deployments using Terraform</li> <li>Experience with AI-driven automations</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Total Rewards</strong></p> <p>At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why <a href="https://www.samsara.com/company/careers/benefits">our rewards</a> are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.</p> <p>Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.</p> <p><strong>Flexible Working </strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity? </h2> <p>We are looking for an experienced and ambitious Sales Manager to lead a team of Account Executives focused on acquiring and expanding relationships with mid-market customers. The ideal candidate combines strong commercial leadership with operational excellence, coaching capability, and a passion for building winning sales cultures in fast-paced SaaS environments.</p> <h2>What will I be doing? </h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of Account Executives</li> <li>Drive consistent pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and revenue performance</li> <li>Support reps through complex commercial negotiations and multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> <li>Build a culture of accountability, performance, and continuous improvement</li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Partnerships teams</li> <li>Recruit, onboard, and develop top sales talent</li> <li>Monitor key sales metrics and identify opportunities to improve execution and conversion rates</li> <li>Contribute to regional go-to-market planning and execution</li> <li>Ensure operational discipline across forecasting, CRM hygiene, and sales processes</li> </ul> <h2>What skills do I need? </h2> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading successful SaaS sales teams</li> <li>Proven track record of delivering and exceeding revenue targets</li> <li>Strong people leadership and coaching capabilities</li> <li>Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles</li> <li>Strong commercial acumen and forecasting discipline</li> <li>Ability to operate effectively across multiple European markets and cultures</li> <li>Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills</li> <li>Experience working in high-growth or scaling technology businesses is preferred</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Unleash Your Potential</strong></p> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.</p> <p>In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Offerings vary by location in line with local practices and requirements. Learn more about working at Fin and the benefits we offer at<a href="http://fin.ai/careers"> fin.ai/careers</a>. We believe that working in person helps us stay connected, collaborate easier and create a great culture while still providing flexibility to work from home. We expect employees to be in the office at least three days per week.</p> <p>We have a radically open and accepting culture at Fin. We respect personal opinion and expression on these topics on personal social platforms on personal time, and do not challenge or confront anyone for their views on non-work related topics. Our goal is to focus on doing incredible work to achieve our goals and unite the company through our <a href="https://www.intercom.com/careers">core values</a>.  </p> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p> </p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

In some circumstances, we can accommodate fellows starting outside the usual cohort timelines — please note in your application if the January 2027 start date doesn't work for you.</p> <h2><strong>What to expect</strong></h2> <ul> <li>4 months of full-time research </li> <li>Direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers </li> <li>Weekly stipend of 4,615 USD / 3,440 GBP / 6,470 CAD / 4,110 EUR + benefits (these vary by country)</li> <li>Substantial funding for compute and other research expenses</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>The interview process will include an initial application, assessments, and interviews. description: We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙 The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1: 💙 Care deeply 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard 🤝 Be your word 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency 🚀 Do your life's best work 🥳 Find the fun Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook . 🎯 Goal expectations As our Special Projects Associate (GTM) , you’ll be the right-hand to our Growth Lead. You will set up Attio well, then build tooling on top of it using AI (e.g. dashboards and maps). You'll be working in a fast-moving commercial environment where accuracy, speed, and proactivity all matter at the same time. You probably won't enjoy this role if you: Prefer to be told what to do over figuring out what to do Treat ops as a support function rather than a growth lever Aren't comfortable getting your hands dirty with data Are content to maintain the status quo rather than improve it Have never built things with AI You will enjoy this role if you are detail-oriented , want extreme ownership , and thrive on making people around you more effective ! 👍 Required experience You have worked in an early-stage startup before (e.g. in GTM, operations or as founder's associate), where you've owned systems, data or process improvement ✅ Must-have traits Proactive problem solver - you don't wait for someone to flag a problem; you find it and fix it end-to-end. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world. 🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception. 💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success! 🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it. 🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together. 🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23). 🚀 An opportunity for real upside 💉 Paid volunteer days. We offer an additional 2 paid days off per year where you can give back to your mission of choice. 🎢 Every 8 weeks we take a day off to socialise as a team. In the past we’ve hiked box hill, raved at All Points East and spent one rainy day at Thorpe park. This works out as 6 working days a year. 📚 Learning budget of £250 annually and time off to spend it - we care about this; this is flexible and based on need but everyone will receive a yearly allocation towards their continual growth. 🍽️ Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success! 🥡 Team takeaways every Monday night 🥗 Health and fitness budget of £60 per month - see more here 🧘‍♂️ An additional 7 days of paid leave is available if you want to take time to learn how to meditate. 💫 Tooling; You’ll have your choice of operating systems and any additional tools you need to do your best work (e.g. keyboard, additional monitors, mouse etc). In 2025, we spent 8 days in a surf camp in France! 👎 No private medical insurance, because we believe in the NHS and we are here to improve it! 🐥 Parental leave: Post passing probation it is: statutory - 6 weeks 90% pay then, SMP for 33 weeks; if you've been an employee for a year: 12 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 27 weeks; and if you have been here for 2 years: 18 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 21 weeks. This will improve over time. We also include up to £9,000 of childcare contribution for primary caregivers to support a five-day return where possible. 👪 Fertility leave. This is why we give an extra 5 days off per year if you or your partner are going through fertility treatment. 🐖 Pension - We operate a standard 3% employer contribution and employees auto-contribute 5% of their salary. We use Nest as our provider. 🏡 Local living benefit - A one-off benefit to support living closer to the office: £5,000 if you live within a 30-minute walk, or £2,500 within a 30-minute bike. LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities Singapore, Geneva or London LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell. Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it. The role This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code. We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds. The role reports to our Head of Commodities. What you'll do Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role) Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role) Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision Building a product clients pay for (~20% of role) Lead discovery conversations and technical demos with LNG trading desks, analysts and commercial teams, and use what they tell you to decide what to build next Work with sales and account management on the first LNG deals and on adding LNG to existing oil and freight accounts: you bring the market credibility and the product, sales runs the commercial process Give sales a clear account of what the product does and why a desk would pay for it, so they can sell it without you in the room Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as the LNG expert What we're looking for Required Deep LNG market expertise: strong working knowledge of global LNG pricing (JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and the relationships between them), netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures A track record of building, not just specifying: tools, models, pipelines or products you built hands-on and that other people rely on Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with the rest of a modern stack: APIs, databases, cloud services and version control Heavy, daily use of AI coding tools to prototype and ship far faster than a traditional build cycle, and the judgement to spot where an LLM gets the market wrong Ownership and drive: you scope the problem, pull in the right people, get it built and shipped, and fix it when it breaks, without waiting for a detailed spec Credible in front of trading desks: able to run a discovery call and a technical demo, and to hear what a client will pay for and what they won't Experience leading or working closely with engineers, and the technical credibility to set direction with them Experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services or a closely related field Ability to turn market complexity into rules, tests and code that make an AI agent answer like a good desk analyst Desirable Experience building AI agents or LLM applications: tool calling, prompt design, retrieval and evaluation Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (code review, testing, CI/CD) Familiarity with LNG data sources: price assessments, vessel tracking and shipping data, terminal and regasification data Experience with pricing, data or analytics platforms in the energy space, or with building one from scratch An existing network within the LNG trading community What success looks like In your first six months, you will have: Led the build and launch of the first version of Sparta's LNG offering: netbacks, arbitrage routes and delivered price curves in clients' hands Built, with the AI team, an LNG expert in Leonidas that answers the way a good desk analyst would, with an evaluation set that proves it Launched at least one automated product, such as a daily brief or a set of alerts, that runs every day Written the LNG rules every Sparta product and agent follows Set up, with data and engineering, pipelines that run and check themselves, so the vertical scales without manual work Put the product in front of LNG desks, helped sales land the first LNG clients, and fed what the market told you back into the roadmap Is this you? This role is for you if you'd rather build the tool than write the note about it, you like being hands-on, you make the people around you build faster too, and you measure what you've built by whether a desk will pay for it. It probably isn't for you if the part of the job you enjoy most is publishing your market view, or you'd rather hand over a spec than help build what's in it. Why Join Sparta? At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded. • Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company • $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment • Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale • Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence • Top-tier tools and technology to support your success What's the Culture Like at Sparta? At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers. The Sparta Code Understanding is non-negotiable Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning. The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed. Ask for forgiveness, not for permission Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not. 90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned. Fall in love with the problem The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to. Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working. It's your fault. Lucky you. If it's on you, it's in your control. True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency. Conflict is a gift Honesty is an expression of care. Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it. Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari: </strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue & Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.</p> </div></div><h3><strong>POSITION DESCRIPTION</strong></h3> <p>This is not a traditional engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.</p> <p>You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.</p> <p>You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.</p> <p>You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.</p> <p> </p> <h4><strong>JOB RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Embed and Build:</strong> Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.</li> <li><strong>Own the Outcome:</strong> Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.</li> <li><strong>Be the Tip of the Spear:</strong> Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.</li> <li><strong>Engineer Solutions for the Mission:</strong> Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.</li> <li><strong>Shape Our Product:</strong> Act as the vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams. You will translate complex, real-world operational needs and feedback into the next generation of Sayari's platform.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>SKILLS & EXPERIENCE</strong></h4> <p><em>Required Skills & Experiences:</em></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).</li> <li>Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.</li> <li>Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.</li> <li>Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.</li> <li>A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred</li> <li>Focus on government missions</li> <li>Must be a U.K. citizen and be able to obtain secret clearance</li> <li>Ability to work at the client site 25-75% of the time.</li> </ul> <p><em>Desired Skills & Experiences:</em></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.</li> <li>Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).</li> <li>Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.</li> <li>Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.</li> <li>Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.</li> <li>Ability to travel up to 50%</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><em>The target base salary for this position is _____ plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</em></p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Benefits: </strong></h3> <div> <ul> <li>100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents</li> <li>Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days</li> <li>Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions</li> <li>A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion</li> <li>Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage),, and parental leave</li> <li>A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you</li> <li>Limitless growth and learning opportunities</li> </ul> </div> <div> </div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunity employer and strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply. We believe diversity and inclusion mean our team members should reflect the diversity of the United States. title: ClayDR - EMEA
description: About Clay AI is unleashing the biggest wave of company creation in history. Clay's mission is to be the engine those companies use to grow to their full potential. Clay predicts the next best action for your business and then helps you take it. We started by aggregating the best data for B2B companies. Then, we built the infrastructure to run any personalized campaign on top of it, including emails, ads, landing pages, and workflows that make reps more productive. Now, we're building agents that can help grow your company for you. We're already helping thousands of customers — including Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and Visa — go to market with unique data, signals, and AI research. In 2026, we raised a $115M Series D at $7.1B Valuation led by Wellington — and are on track to cross $200M in revenue this quarter. We also launched a $1M Scholarship fund for GTME Education. Some things to know about us: Our community includes 17,000+ customers, 200+ integration partners, 125+ agencies, 50+ Clay clubs , and 30k members on Slack. Our culture is unique inside and outside of work. Our team members are also DJs, activists, writers, clowns, marathoners, skydivers, psychedelic therapists, social workers, and more. All employees can work with world-class coaches who specialize in creativity, management, and more. Our operating principles — including negative maintenance and non-attached action — guide our work. Read more about them here . Read about us in the NYT , Forbes , First Round Review , and more . Hear from our employees directly on our Glassdoor page! We're hiring ClayDRs (fka SDRs)! A team of early-career sales professionals who convert high-volume demand into qualified opportunities and exceptional lead experiences. You'll partner with our Growth team, which sources leads and handles the manual work (using Clay!) so you can focus entirely on high-impact prospecting activities and conversations. What makes this different: You'll book meetings and directly influence our product roadmap, all while learning to leverage AI and automation to become a top-performing GTME. What You'll Do Promptly follow up with inbound and outbound prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to ensure no lead is left behind. Gain a deep understanding of the GTM industry and key personas (RevOps, Marketing, Sales, etc.) to identify problems and use cases that Clay can solve. Qualify leads and book meetings for GTM Engineers, ensuring they are equipped with the correct information to win the deal. Provide structured feedback on signals, workflows, and plays to help us improve Clay based on real-life testing. What You'll Bring 1–2 years of Sales, SDR, or BDR experience in a SaaS or tech environment preferred (open to exceptional entry-level candidates). You are in London and excited about an in-person office environment (think 5 days per week). You're resilient, energized by building relationships, and genuinely excited to learn. Interest in modern sales tools and contributing to GTM strategy and product roadmap. Ability to balance high-volume outreach with thoughtful experimentation and feedback. title: Field Account Executive - Glasgow
description: Lightspeed is looking for a Field Sales Account Executive , to join our growing UK Hospo team. You will be implementing a strategy that will require you to have a physical presence across Glasgow. Each month you will drive the sales cycle from lead generation, to demonstrations, to closing deals. Lightspeed’s Hospitality team is now in hyper-growth mode. Our process has been refined and optimised at a smaller scale in the last few years, now is the time to expand our team and our reach. What you’ll be doing: Becoming an expert in the UK Hospo industry Monitoring the organisation’s competitors, their products and marketing strategies Researching and forecasting sales and developing sales strategies and methods and evaluating their effectiveness based on your catchment area Converting prospects into successful customers through customer sales methods such as door-to-door, cold calling and presentations - all in person. Carrying out the whole sales cycle which includes identifying and developing leads, meeting with your clients, creating value propositions, structuring financial deals, negotiating contracts, and closing deals. Visiting customers on a regular basis to identify their business challenges & pain points Successfully running in person demonstrations of the hospitality product Maintaining up-to-date records within Salesforce CRM solution Processing sales quotes and deadlines in an accurate manner Working with the marketing and sales team on developing new strategies to grow our sales pipeline based on conversations and input you will be having in the market Driving performance to consistently meet monthly, quarterly and annual goals Create new business through network events What you’ll be bringing: Relevant sales experience in a Field and outbound environment, preferably in a solution-sales / technology-related Strong experience in hospitality Strong understanding of sales development best practices Ability to manage time effectively and efficiently Excellent customer service and telephone skills, including strong listening, verbal and written communication Demonstrated ability to meet and/or exceed sales targets Experience using Salesforce or comparable CRM experience to manage and organise pipeline Proficiency in English, any other language is a nice to have An entrepreneurial and agile mindset, a bias toward action and an ability to pivot when needed to meet business needs and objectives To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Where to from here? Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here . Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs. Who we are: Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks. Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries. title: Head of Data
description: Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit. Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification. Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited. If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team. Mulberry is looking for an experienced Head of Data to establish and lead our enterprise data capability. This is a pivotal new role with the opportunity to shape how data is architected, governed, managed and used across Mulberry. You will define our data operating model, establish clear ownership and governance, build a cross-functional data community and create the foundations for trusted, accessible and valuable data across the business. Working closely with senior business leaders and Technology, you will act as the single point of accountability for Data Enablement across Mulberry, ensuring our approach is driven by business priorities and delivers measurable value. Alongside establishing the organisational capability, you will help shape Mulberry’s future technology data capability. This could involve evolving our existing Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery environment or moving towards an alternative solution. The role will ensure that our business needs, operating model and long-term ambitions inform those choices. What you’ll be responsible for Define and implement Mulberry’s enterprise Data strategy and operating model, including ownership, governance, stewardship and decision rights. Establish a pragmatic Data Governance framework, covering definitions, quality, lineage, metadata, standards and accountability. Create and lead a cross-functional Data Community, establishing Data Owners and Data Stewards across key business areas and equipping them with the guidance, training and practical tools needed to fulfil their responsibilities. Act as the enterprise point of accountability for Data Enablement, bringing together business and Technology priorities. Lead the business direction of our Data Foundations programme and help transition it into a sustainable, long-term capability. Establish common definitions, authoritative data sources and trusted enterprise measures, reducing multiple versions of the truth and manual reconciliation. Work with Technology to define the business requirements and guiding principles for our future data architecture and platform. Develop a prioritised Data roadmap focused on delivering tangible commercial and operational value. Build data literacy and enable greater, appropriately governed self-service across the organisation. Create the foundations required for future analytics, automation and AI opportunities. Work with relevant Legal and Technology stakeholders to embed appropriate data classification, access, retention and lifecycle controls, with clear ownership of data risks and remediation. About you You’ll combine strong Data expertise with commercial judgement and the ability to lead enterprise-wide change. We’re looking for someone who has: Significant experience in Data leadership, Data Governance, Data Management or enterprise Data transformation. Experience building or materially evolving a Data operating model, rather than simply managing an established function. Strong knowledge of Data Governance, ownership, stewardship, quality, lineage and metadata. Experience establishing accountability across multiple business functions and building the internal and external capabilities needed to deliver data outcomes. A strong commercial mindset, with the ability to translate business challenges into clear Data priorities and outcomes. The confidence to influence senior leaders and constructively challenge both business and technical stakeholders. Sufficient understanding of modern cloud Data platforms to help shape technology decisions without needing to be the technical architect. Experience developing Data strategies and investment roadmaps. Clear, engaging communication skills and the ability to make Data understandable to non-technical audiences. Knowledge of GCP, BigQuery or comparable cloud data platforms. Experience within retail, luxury, consumer goods or manufacturing would be advantageous. What success looks like Within your first year, you will have established: A clear and functioning enterprise Data operating model. Active Data Owners and Data Stewards across priority areas. A strong cross-functional Data Community. Common definitions and governance for critical enterprise data and KPIs. Improved visibility of Data quality, lineage, ownership and risk. A prioritised Data roadmap linked to measurable business outcomes. A clear future technology Data capability and supporting organisational model. Greater trust in and use of Data for decision-making across Mulberry. Why this role matters This is not a traditional reporting, BI or technical Data role. It is an opportunity to build an enterprise capability from the ground up. Data is increasingly critical to how Mulberry makes commercial and operational decisions, and to how we develop our future technology and AI capabilities. The Head of Data will play a central role in creating the ownership, governance, capability and culture needed to unlock that opportunity. Culture Embrace and demonstrate the Mulberry values and behaviours: honesty, dynamism, and a community-oriented spirit. Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues. Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand. Sustainability As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. You’ll be encouraged to incorporate environmentally and socially responsible practices into your work, supporting our Made to Last strategy across Climate, Circularity, and Community. Help foster a culture where diversity is celebrated and every individual feels valued, respected, and included. Champion equity, empathy, and understanding in all interactions - internally and externally. What we can do for you As well as the opportunity to play an important role in Mulberry’s future, you’ll have access to a range of benefits, including: Competitive salary Generous staff discount and access to staff sales Your birthday off Pension contributions and life assurance Learning and development opportunities Two paid volunteering days per year Access to Help@Hand wellbeing support, including remote GP appointments, mental health support, physiotherapy, personal training and retail discounts Mulberry is an equal opportunities employer and we are passionate about hiring and developing the best talent. All hiring decisions are made only on the basis of qualifications, skills or experience and as they relate to the particular role. title: Data Engineer
description: Born in 1971, the roots of Mulberry are in Somerset, England. For more than fifty years, Mulberry has been a British lifestyle brand, internationally acclaimed for quality and design capturing the Mulberry Spirit. Sustainability has been part of the Mulberry ethos since the brand's inception, in recognition of our purpose-driven approach, in 2024 we proudly achieved B Corp Certification. Today, we are a global brand, but our values remain the same; we are committed to improving our impact on people and the planet. To do this our people are honest, dynamic, and community spirited. If these are values you share, we would love you to join our team. We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join Mulberry and play a key role in building the data foundations that will support the next stage of our reporting, analytics and insight capabilities. Joining as a member of our Data Foundations Project, you’ll help transform how data is brought together, structured and used across the business. You’ll design and build robust data pipelines, models and integration patterns that improve the quality, accessibility and trusted use of data. This is a hands-on role where you’ll work closely with colleagues across Technology, the wider business and specialist third-party partners. Alongside engineering and delivery, you’ll help shape the technical standards and architecture that underpin our data platform, creating the foundations for reporting, customer insight and future artificial intelligence use cases. What You’ll Be Doing Data Platform Architecture Working with the Head of Data, design and document our target data platform architecture in line with the Data Foundations roadmap and wider technology standards. Develop engineering principles, integration patterns, data models and technical standards covering data ingestion, transformation, storage and access. Assess the integration of source systems, platforms and services to create a coherent and scalable data architecture. Identify architectural risks, technical debt and dependencies, recommending practical solutions. Data Engineering & Integration Design, build, test and maintain robust ETL and ELT pipelines across our core business systems and third-party data sources. Develop and optimise data structures, datasets and transformation processes, primarily within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery. Create reusable integration components and engineering patterns that improve consistency and delivery. Make sure data pipelines are effectively monitored, documented and supported throughout their lifecycle. Investigate and resolve complex data, integration and platform issues, partnering with internal teams and external specialists where needed. Data Modelling, Quality & Governance Design logical and physical data models that support trusted reporting, analytics and operational use cases. Build a semantic layer to support self-service reporting tools and an MCP layer for natural language interrogation. Implement data quality controls, validation and monitoring to improve the accuracy, completeness and consistency of our data. Enable data lineage, metadata and auditability across priority data domains. Partner with data owners and stakeholders to establish clear definitions, ownership and appropriate access. Ensure solutions support data protection, retention, security and relevant regulatory requirements. Delivery, Collaboration & Technical Leadership Turn business and architectural requirements into clear technical designs and practical engineering solutions. Build strong relationships across the business, Technology teams and specialist partners to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions. Provide technical guidance across data engineering and platform delivery, including reviewing third-party designs and code. Produce clear technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, data flows, mappings, standards and support information. Support knowledge transfer and capability development across our internal Technology teams. Help shape the priorities and ongoing evolution of our data platform roadmap. About You You’ll bring significant experience designing and building modern, cloud-based data platforms, combined with strong hands-on engineering capability. We’re looking for: Significant experience designing and building modern cloud-based data platforms. Strong hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery and associated data services. Proven experience designing, developing and supporting enterprise data pipelines using ETL and ELT techniques. Strong SQL capability and experience working with structured and semi-structured data. Experience in data architecture, data modelling, integration architecture and data warehousing. Experience integrating data from multiple enterprise and third-party source systems. Experience implementing data quality controls, lineage, metadata and governance requirements within technical solutions. The ability to take incomplete or inconsistent information and turn it into clear technical designs and delivery priorities. Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. The ability to work independently, lead technical workstreams and deliver high-quality outputs in a changing environment. It would be great if you also have: Experience within retail, consumer, luxury, fashion, ecommerce or omnichannel environments. Experience working with ERP, point of sale, product, inventory, pricing, customer, ecommerce or marketing platforms. Experience working with specialist consultancies, implementation partners or managed service providers. A relevant Google Cloud or data engineering certification. Location This role is based in our London office, with travel to other Mulberry offices and locations as business needs require. From time to time, the role may also need to support planned releases or critical data platform issues outside normal working hours. Support Mulberry to deliver an inclusive culture, through behaving in a way that is open-minded and respectful towards others, and understanding that your views, opinions, and experiences may not always be shared by your colleagues. Act as an ambassador for Mulberry and communicate positively about the brand. Sustainability: As a certified B Corp, we are committed to using business as a force for good. title: Senior Treasury Manager
description: About Finom Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform. We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe. Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain. At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole. Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business. We are looking for a Senior Treasury Manager to build and run Finom's treasury function. Finom safeguards a significant book of customer funds across its regulated entities. Net interest income on that book is a meaningful revenue line, and it will grow. Today the function is up and running: the money is placed, the investment policy is in place, and a large part of the book sits with an external asset manager. What we are building now is the machinery around it — an evidenced limit framework, look-through into what our managers actually hold, automated investment accounting, and a reconciled NII number we can defend to an auditor and a regulator. That is the job. You will take part in building it, and you will run it while it is being built. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of regulation, liquidity, and commercial impact — not a back-office position. It suits someone who has done this before in a regulated environment and wants to do it again without four layers of committee above them. What you'll own Liquidity and funding Daily liquidity positioning and float management across entities and accounts Intraday funding of payment channels; nostro and correspondent account management Collateral and minimum-balance obligations across card schemes, T2, and credit providers Contingency funding — the playbook for the day we need €20m by tomorrow morning A daily treasury balance sheet — net liquidity and net capital available — that reconciles Safeguarding and portfolio Portfolio management of safeguarded client funds: term deposits, MMFs, short-dated debt, held directly and via external managers Safeguarding adequacy: shortfall detection, top-up execution, same-currency discipline Instrument eligibility screening under CRR risk-weight, maturity and WAL constraints, and UCITS/MMF rules Independent, evidenced validation that externally managed allocations sit inside mandate — position-level look-through, daily monitoring of concentration, maturity, WAL and credit quality, breach escalation NII forecasting, attribution, and reconciled performance reporting; treasury inputs into the financial model and company forecast Governance and controls Ownership of the investment policy, limit framework, and eligible-instrument register Treasury governance: decision pack, agenda, decision log, and delegated-authority register Pre-deal checks and post-trade evidencing, designed so that the first line executes and the second line challenges Covenant tracking across credit facilities Regulator, external audit, and second-line engagement on treasury and safeguarding matters Systems and data Selection and implementation of investment accounting and treasury tooling — a Clearwater/Advent-class implementation is already in flight and will be yours Custodian, asset-manager and bank data feeds; API connectivity where it exists and pragmatic alternatives where it doesn't Replacing manual spreadsheet processes with something that survives your holiday Commercial Bank, custodian, broker and asset-manager relationships: onboarding, commercial terms, mandate setting, service review Challenging our managers on allocation, transparency and fees — and changing them if the answers are weak What good looks like in the first 12 months Investment policy and limit framework live, with treasury governance running on a documented decision log Daily, evidenced mandate compliance across the full book — we can answer "are we inside the boundaries?" in minutes, not weeks Investment accounting platform implemented; monthly close on the portfolio no longer manual An NII number that is reconciled, attributed, and forecastable A contingency liquidity playbook that has been tested rather than written Who you are 5+ years in treasury, ALM, fixed income, or portfolio management at a regulated financial institution, EMI/PI, or asset manager Direct experience with client money or safeguarding under PSD2 / EMD — core to this role, not adjacent to it Experience building or materially rebuilding a treasury function, not only operating inside an established one Strong command of bond math, yield and duration, MMF mechanics, and credit and concentration risk at instrument level Track record of automating manual treasury processes and implementing treasury or investment accounting systems Comfortable working with position-level data directly — you can interrogate a portfolio file rather than wait for a report Experience with regulators, external audit, and external asset managers (mandate setting, IMA terms, performance challenge) Sound judgement under time pressure in a lean environment with real accountability and limited cover Strong Excel skills Fluent English Nice to have Familiarity with IFRS 9 or Dutch GAAP (RJ 290) financial instrument accounting SQL or Python Experience in a firm transitioning toward a banking licence Experience using AI tools (e.g. LLMs, copilots) to accelerate analytical and reporting workflows What You Will Get In Return Make a genuine impact on the product Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us.
