title: Senior Data Science Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do.</p> <p>Our EMEA Data Science organisation sits at the heart of Deliveroo and Wolt, powering decision-making across product, commercial and operational teams through experimentation, causal inference and deep business understanding. As part of DoorDash, our EMEA Data Science team brings together colleagues across Deliveroo and Wolt, creating opportunities to learn from different markets and tackle complex local-commerce challenges.</p> <p>We’re looking for a Senior Data Science Manager to shape data science strategy across a broad area of our Logistics organisation. You’ll combine strong people leadership, technical judgement and commercial thinking to help our teams make better decisions and deliver measurable business impact.</p> <h2><strong>About The Logistics Team</strong></h2> <p>Logistics makes our marketplace work in the real world: connecting riders with orders and helping deliveries happen efficiently and reliably. The organisation works on problems such as predicting demand, improving delivery-time estimates, and matching orders with riders, all in an efficient way to ensure we can offer the most affordable pricing to our customers.</p> <p>These are interconnected challenges. Decisions about supply, incentives and network efficiency can affect consumers, riders and restaurant and retail partners at the same time. Data Science helps us understand those relationships, test new approaches and balance delivery reliability, rider experience and sustainable business economics.</p> <p>It’s an environment where rigorous experimentation meets real-world complexity, and where your team’s work can shape both everyday operational decisions and longer-term product strategy.</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Be Doing </strong></h2> <p>You’ll own the data science direction and measurable impact of a broad Logistics problem space spanning multiple cross-functional teams. You’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Set strategy and priorities with Product, Engineering and Operations leaders, focusing investment on the highest-impact opportunities across immediate needs and longer-term goals.</li> <li>Build and develop a high-performing, inclusive team through hiring, coaching and performance management, growing leaders who can deliver independently.</li> <li>Guide solutions to complex marketplace challenges, from balancing supply and demand to evaluating incentives and improving delivery performance and economics.</li> <li>Set the technical bar for experimentation, causal inference and analysis, staying close enough to challenge approaches and ensure decisions reflect real marketplace effects.</li> <li>Influence senior stakeholders and align teams around shared outcomes, resolving competing priorities and turning evidence into product and operational decisions.</li> <li>Directly lead projects that resolve highly complex challenges, which often span across multiple parts of the business and unlock new vectors of impact, boosting company-level goals.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You’ll Need to Thrive</strong></h2> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring:</p> <ul> <li>A track record of leading and developing high-performing data science or closely related analytical teams, with responsibility for complex work spanning multiple teams or business areas.</li> <li>Experience setting analytical strategy and allocating people and effort across competing priorities, with clear evidence of product, operational or commercial impact.</li> <li>Strong technical foundations in experimentation, causal inference and statistical analysis, with the judgement to select appropriate methods, challenge conclusions and coach experienced practitioners.</li> <li>The ability to reason about interconnected systems and trade-offs, including how an intervention in one part of a marketplace can affect outcomes elsewhere.</li> <li>Experience influencing senior cross-functional leaders, aligning teams around shared goals and turning complex evidence into clear, actionable recommendations.</li> <li>A thoughtful approach to building teams: hiring, coaching, managing performance and developing future technical and people leaders.</li> <li>Comfort creating structure in ambiguous environments, making pragmatic decisions with incomplete information and adapting as new evidence emerges.</li> </ul> <p>Experience developing other people managers would be particularly valuable. Experience in marketplaces, logistics, mobility, pricing, incentives or other operationally complex businesses is helpful, but not essential. We also value leaders who can bring relevant approaches from other domains.</p> <p>You don’t need to have worked on every problem listed here. We’re interested in the depth of your leadership, the quality of your judgement and the impact you enable through others.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior CRM Executive - Lifecycle
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h3><strong>About the team</strong></h3> <p>This position will be part of the central CRM & Ops team, composed of 18+ specialists, dedicated to driving and executing global strategic initiatives to grow and retain our New Customer base. Collectively, the team is targeted on growing orders, expanding our subscriber base, improving engagement metrics to retain Deliveroo customers. Serving as the voice of the customer, the CRM & Ops team does this by enhancing personalised user experiences, activating best-in-class campaigns, and putting relevancy at the heart of everything. </p> <h3><strong>The Role</strong></h3> <p>As a Marketing Manager within the Lifecycle CRM & Ops team you are the voice of Deliveroo when speaking with our customers across the globe. You'll operate under a hybrid work model, spending a minimum of three days a week at our London HQ.</p> <p>Reporting into the Senior Marketing Manager on the New Customer squad, and working closely with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Global CRM, Marketing Promotions, and Data Science, You’ll be a technical, commercially minded CRM marketer who is hands-on in the tooling: building Lifecycle journeys, setting up experiments and audiences, and configuring promotions and in-app merchandising. You’ll have end-to-end ownership of the New Customer Lifecycle, from journey design and build through to measurement and ROI. You’ll also use personalisation and AI to make journeys more relevant. Your primary focus will be on creating customer-centric journeys that are highly relevant, using the right channels at the right time to deliver meaningful business impact, while working with local markets as you scale your initiatives internationally. </p> <h3><strong>What you'll be doing</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to support growing the new customer base by combining data-driven insights with CRM best practice to initiate and deliver programs internationally </li> <li>Build and configure multi-channel journeys (email, push, in-app), including audience logic, triggers, testing and QA</li> <li>Design and build multi-variant Lifecycle experiments</li> <li>Create promotions for new customer acquisition and retention, ensuring accurate setup, targeting and tracking</li> <li>Manage in-app merchandising placements, working with Product and Marketing Promotions</li> <li>Deliver personalisation at scale, and test where AI can improve content and efficiency</li> <li>Own operational delivery, optimisation, reporting of campaigns and weekly trading</li> <li>Proactively monitor and report on campaigns to stakeholders & propose/manage changes and optimisations where necessary</li> <li>Collaborate with the New Customer Lifecycle Manager and Marketing Promotions teams to develop the global CRM new customers lifecycle strategy</li> <li>Collaborate with stakeholders on key projects to create and implement test strategies that optimises performance of new & existing campaigns</li> <li>Be comfortable with data targeting, segmentation & analysis - pulling it, manipulating it and interpreting it, whilst using marketing technology to help achieve customer touchpoints faster and more efficiently than ever before</li> <li>Drive innovative ideas and solutions in response to business and customer needs</li> <li>Provide regular communication with stakeholders, such as the central marketing team, product and engineering teams and local markets, to ensure workloads & deadlines are managed efficiently (we love Slack channels for everything)</li> <li>Conduct post campaign reporting, pulling out the most interesting lessons and using these to guide your future ideas</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree (Marketing or Business preferred) or strong relevant experience</li> <li>A minimum of 3+ years CRM experience</li> <li>Can work in a fast-paced environment and prioritise workload</li> <li>Attention to detail and campaign deadlines are adhered to, maintaining high standards of accuracy</li> <li>Highly computer literate with:</li> <ul> <li>HTML familiarity (ability to understand where changes need to be made)</li> <li>Liquid logic </li> </ul> <li>Technical knowledge in CRM automation development</li> <li>Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders groups</li> <li>Data visualisation tools & reporting experience (Looker preferred)</li> <li>CRM deployment experience (Braze or similar is a plus!)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why Deliveroo</strong></h3> <p>Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.</p> <p>We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.</p> <h3><strong>Workplace & Benefits</strong></h3> <p>At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. You are comfortable being the "person in charge" during your shift and making calls that impact the business.</li> <li><strong>Incident Command:</strong> Extensive experience operating as an incident commander. You can flex into deep engineering work but also possess the executive presence to coordinate responders and communicate status to leadership.</li> <li><strong>Investigations:</strong> Expert-level capability investigating threats in enterprise and production environments, taking ownership from identification to resolution.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge/Tools/Techniques:</strong> Deep understanding of security tooling (SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, NDR, SOAR) and experience extending or building on it. You are proficient in applying Incident Response frameworks (NIST IR Lifecycle, Cyber Kill Chain, MITRE ATT&CK) to real-world scenarios, and you collaborate effectively with engineering colleagues, leveraging extensive expertise across infrastructure and technologies (Public Cloud, OS, Virtualization, Containerization, Networking, Build/Development infrastructure, and Hardware).</li> <li><strong>Education:</strong> Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field; advanced degree preferred or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>A Builder-Operator:</strong> You would rather automate a problem out of existence than staff around it and you hold yourself to an engineering bar even under incident pressure.</li> <li><strong>A Strategic Self-Starter:</strong> You don't wait for instructions. You identify gaps in coverage — especially those unique to regional or time-zone-specific challenges — and fix them.</li> <li><strong>A Detailed Thinker:</strong> You enjoy exploring the details and considering the second- and third-order effects of your decisions.</li> <li><strong>An Eager Problem Solver:</strong> You are drawn to complex issues rather than avoidant of them.</li> <li><strong>Emboldened to Make Change:</strong> You instinctively ask what you can do to improve the situation rather than waiting to be prompted.</li> <li><strong>Compelled by our Mission:</strong> You are driven by the opportunity to protect our community and the safe space we've created.</li> <li><strong>A Calculated Risk Taker:</strong> You move fast, navigating reasonable risks to take action and build capabilities as quickly as possible.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).</p> <p>Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. title: Senior Manager, Paid Social
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><strong>Senior Manager, Paid Social</strong></span></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">We are seeking a <strong>Senior Manager, Paid Social</strong></span> <em data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">to join our growing team. </span></em></p> <p>Paid social is one of the main ways Quince finds new customers, and this role sits at the centre of it. As Senior Manager, Growth Marketing (Paid Social), you will own strategy, execution and optimisation across Meta and other social platforms for a set of Quince departments, turning business goals into efficient media investment and steady, scalable growth.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, analytical role. You will manage significant media budgets against clear efficiency targets (ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS), work out what is really driving performance, and work closely with creative, merchandising and analytics colleagues so that targeting and creative keep getting better. The role is critical to scaling our paid social acquisition engine.</p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2663" data-local-id="e0c03b8d-8a8f-42ae-b3e9-26b5a2308ae6"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6">Responsibilities</span></strong></p> <p><strong>Paid social strategy and investment</strong> (the main focus of the role)</p> <ul> <li>Own paid social strategy and delivery for selected Quince departments across Meta, TikTok and emerging social channels.</li> <li>Manage and optimise significant paid media budgets to meet customer acquisition and efficiency targets.</li> <li>Monitor performance across campaigns, audiences and creative, and act quickly on what you find.</li> <li>Run a continuous programme of testing across audience segmentation, creative formats, messaging, bidding and budget allocation.</li> <li>Scale the campaigns that work, and deal with underperformance promptly.</li> <li>Adjust spend quickly in response to performance signals and changing product priorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance analysis and optimisation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyse campaign results across different attribution frameworks.</li> <li>Identify what drives incremental customer acquisition and revenue growth, and turn those findings into practical campaign and creative decisions.</li> <li>Build and maintain dashboards, reporting frameworks and performance analyses.</li> <li>Work with our analytics team to improve the accuracy of measurement and attribution.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Creative and testing collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Creative, Studio and Production teams to shape creative that performs.</li> <li>Develop ways of working that make sure creative suits each platform.</li> <li>Keep testing volume high enough to support growth targets, with a steady supply of new creative.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-functional collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Merchandising and Product to agree priority categories and launches.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics and Data on attribution and measurement.</li> <li>Present performance insights and growth opportunities to leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth experimentation and channel development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Find opportunities to expand into new paid social surfaces and formats.</li> <li>Test new growth approaches, including audience expansion, creator-led ads and performance creative formats.</li> <li>Keep improving our testing frameworks so we can run more experiments and learn more from each one.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <p>In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>manage and optimise significant paid social spend for your departments against clear targets for ROAS, CAC and NC MTA ROAS;</li> <li>drive scalable customer acquisition through testing, experimentation and analysis;</li> <li>find new audience, creative and bidding opportunities that unlock incremental growth;</li> <li>build a high-performing creative pipeline in partnership with the creative teams;</li> <li>use data and attribution models title: Senior Financial Control Analyst, 9 Month Fixed Term Contract
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. As we expand we need to make sure we can support our businesses and control our processes, so we are growing our team to meet these exciting new challenges! We are looking to introduce a Senior Financial Control Analyst on a 9 Month Fixed Term Contract. </p> <p>Our team sits within Monzo’s Finance collective and our job is getting the numbers right. We’re currently a team of seven qualified accountants, split between our Cardiff and London offices, and we ensure the ledger’s correct at every month-end. We work closely with all areas of Finance and the product teams to make that happen.</p> <p><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by… </strong></p> <p>We're looking for a proactive, enthusiastic and commercially-minded accountant to work on our financial accounting, and help us build a world-class finance function. This role would be well suited to a qualified accountant with 2+ years of post-qualification experience.</p> <p>We have some really exciting challenges under way like making sure we maximise our new SAP S4/HANA general ledger, expanding into the European Union, pushing forward with our automation plans, continuing to grow our customer base, growing our lending business and adding to our marketplace. You’ll work on scaling Monzo in a controlled way, while helping us optimise our financial control processes with the help of technology. You’ll report to our Financial Control Manager.</p> <p><strong>Your day-to-day:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage a tight process with the rest of our internal Finance team to ensure a swift month-end close process and group consolidation.</li> <li>Understand the business and our products to write insightful management commentary.</li> <li>Understand our accounting systems and make sure we are taking advantage of all features we can to minimise manual elements of reporting.</li> <li>Embrace the opportunity to improve and transform processes, driving incremental improvements through to adoption of AI.</li> <li>Learn SQL skills to run reports and propose solutions that make our processes efficient and scalable.</li> <li>Support our year end process working with external auditors and our Financial Reporting squad.</li> <li>Help review new products, assessing the accounting and implementing them in our banking platform and accounting system.</li> <li>Work with the business to assess the impact of changes in accounting standards and make proposals on accounting policy matters for new products launched.</li> <li>Help maintain the integrity of our chart of accounts and financial static data.</li> <li>Resolve miscellaneous inquiries and support the overall finance team wherever needed - from forecasting and valuations, to bank transfers, transfer pricing and tax policy research!</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a qualified accountant with a few years’ post-qualification experience, ideally in financial reporting/controlling teams and working in a retail banking environment</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of technical accounting standards</li> <li>You have a great eye for detail</li> <li>You’re fascinated by the banking and regulatory landscape, and have a good understanding of key financial controls</li> <li>You’re a self-starter and enjoy tackling what needs doing, whether it’s making a bank transfer or pulling together reports for investors</li> <li>You’re comfortable translating complex information into simple words for people with diverse backgrounds</li> <li>You’re interested in using data (SQL skills would be a bonus)</li> <li>You embrace change and are motivated to improve and innovate process</li> <li>You thrive in a dynamic and constantly evolving environment</li> <li>What we’re doing at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>🙌 What’s in it for you</p> <p>💰£56,000 - £75,000. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruiter Screening Conversation </li> <li>Initial HM Interview </li> <li>Role Specific Interview </li> <li>Behavioural Interview </li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo.<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo"> You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TP1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. You will be accountable for turning complex customer and business problems into software products that deliver measurable impact.</p> <p>Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you’ll lead product initiatives end-to-end,  from identifying and deeply understanding the right problems to solve, through discovery and delivery, to launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.</p> <p>You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy, proactively building context across customers, the market, internal stakeholders, data, and technology to understand what Reachdesk needs to achieve its goals. title: Senior Staff Product Engineer
description: About hyperexponential (hx) At hyperexponential, we're building the AI-powered platform that enables the world's most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms. Until now, insurance has been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We're changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence. Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we're scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world's largest insurers, with zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx. What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world's first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates. What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn't tied to title or tenure; it's defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you'll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure. If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next. About the Engineering team At hyperexponential, engineering is at the heart of our mission to transform the insurance industry. Our engineers build and scale, enabling insurers to model complex risks and make smarter pricing decisions at speed. By combining deep technical expertise with creativity, the team pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in insurance technology. Within engineering, our product teams are cross-functional, pairing frontend and backend engineers with designers and product managers. This enables end-to-end ownership of features, with engineers contributing across design, architecture, implementation, and testing. Collaboration is a core part of how we work, ensuring that every release is both technically sound and valuable to our users. How we work We're in the middle of a deliberate shift in how hx builds. Everyone in product development is a Builder , and the Product Engineer is the default unit of how we work. We organise around problems, not permanent teams. Small pods , usually of two to four Product Engineers, form around the highest-value problem, own it end-to-end from discovery through to running it in production, and re-form as priorities change. Pods sit inside value streams, each owning a customer outcome and led by a Stream Lead who decides which problems the stream takes on and holds the bar for what ships. Your growth sits elsewhere: a Career Mentor owns your development and progression, so you can move to where the most important problem is without your career following the org chart. We hire Product Engineers into hx, not into a fixed team, domain, or layer of the stack. You'll start in the stream where your strengths and our highest-value problems meet, and move as the problems move. Product Engineers are T-shaped: deep expertise in software engineering, plus enough product and design judgement to make routine calls yourself. An embedded PM or designer raises a pod's ceiling on the hardest problems, but is never a gate between you and the customer. This is also a deliberately AI-native role, and one of the areas where we're moving fastest. A pod of three owns its problem whole, which means going wherever it leads: front end, back end, data, or infrastructure. You don't need to be full-stack by trade, but you do need to be comfortable working outside your strongest layer. The Product Engineer role is the same at every level. What scales is the size of the problem you own, how expensive your decisions are to reverse, and how far your judgement travels beyond your pod. At Level 5 , that looks like this. What you'll be doing Taking a customer problem from discovery to production inside a pod, getting close to customers yourself, framing the problem, and shipping in small increments guided by real customer signal rather than internal opinion. Directing AI agents to draft implementation, tests, and migrations, then reviewing, integrating, and hardening that work. You'll write intent precisely enough to brief both a teammate and an agent, and own correctness and maintainability regardless of how the first draft was produced. Designing and delivering robust production systems where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency matter, with the tests and observability that make complex behaviour safe to evolve. Working across the codebase wherever the problem leads, including areas your pod doesn't steward, with stewards looped in proportionate to the risk rather than handing work off and waiting. Moving between pods, problems, and streams as priorities change, ramping fast on unfamiliar domains and leaving what you built running well behind you. Taking full accountability for outcomes rather than just your code changes: raising risks early, and deciding rather than escalating. What you'll need to have done Built and shipped production systems end-to-end, from design through rollout, monitoring, and iteration, in settings where correctness, performance, and resource efficiency mattered. Designed testing and observability that made complex behaviour understandable, debuggable, and safe to evolve. Worked effectively in a polyglot environment, choosing the right tool for the problem and picking up unfamiliar languages, domains, and codebases fast. Strong systems experience, for example in Rust, C/C++, or Python, is valued, and we'll upskill you where there are gaps. Shipped work outside your strongest layer of the stack when the problem needed it, picking up the front end, the data layer, or the infrastructure rather than waiting for someone else to. Used AI tools as a serious part of how you build, with the judgement to direct, review, and stand behind what they produce. Carried product and design judgement into your engineering work, shaping the solution rather than only implementing a spec and making sensible calls under ambiguity. Owned outcomes beyond your immediate task, taking decisions rather than escalating them. At Level 5 we'll also look for Set technical direction on a hard problem other engineers built on, and been judged on whether you made them faster and safer rather than on the size of your team. Held a quality bar across other people's work without becoming the gate they wait on. Led cross-cutting or decoupling work that teams adopted because it was the best path, not because it was mandated. You’re unlikely to thrive here if You prefer following detailed instructions rather than experimenting and finding your own approach. You are uncomfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders to understand their challenges. You avoid tackling ambiguous or open-ended problems where the solution isn’t obvious. If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us. Compensation At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally. Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make. Benefits £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development. 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total). Company pension scheme via Penfold. Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life . Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno. Private healthcare insurance through AXA. Income protection and Life Insurance. Cycle to Work Scheme. Additional perks Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.). Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights. Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry. Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together. Interview process Initial chat with our Talent team Lead Hirer Interview Live AI Skills Assessment Values Interview with the CPTO Meet the CEO Our commitment to Diversity hxers are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive. Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you're energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team. Next steps If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome. title: Sales Manager, UK - SMB/MM/Enterprise
description: About Dust Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it. With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast. We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026. Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 . The Role We’re hiring a hands-on sales leader for the UK. You’ll build, lead, and coach the regional Sales team, deliver against ARR and pipeline goals, and build a repeatable local growth engine. You'll act as the business lead for your market, with accountability for revenue. As a sales leader, you'll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable sales approach that fits your market. As an orchestrator, you'll coordinate the local pipeline generation activities that feed your number, including marketing and pre-sales. You'll work closely with leaders across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, and influence how they support your market's priorities. What you’ll do Own the region’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Work with the CRO to set priorities, understand capacity needs, and support the team to deliver against the plan. Build and lead the regional Sales team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop sellers, while staying hands-on in priority opportunities from prospecting and discovery through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close. Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on regional customer conversations, deal patterns, and market needs. Build and refine a repeatable regional sales approach using pipeline, win/loss learning, and customer outcomes. Drive the plan in partnership with field marketing to set priorities for events, campaigns, customer advocacy and community programs, and direct how field marketing resources are used to support your pipeline and ARR goals. Partner with the marketing leadership, who own field marketing standards, methods and team management, to make sure regional programs are well executed, measured and consistent with Dust's broader marketing approach Partner with BDR and Growth leaders to build a qualified pipeline through a deliberate mix of outbound and other locally effective channels. Set direction for how Partnerships can support regional priorities. Work with the Partnerships lead to identify opportunities for sourcing, co-selling, or delivery. Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support credible evaluations, successful implementations, customer outcomes, and expansion. Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust. Market-specific focus United Kingdom Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof. What we’re looking for A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market. You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close. Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing. A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style. An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth. What success looks like The region delivers against its ARR and pipeline goals while developing a repeatable sales approach suited to local customers. The team builds customer trust and referenceable outcomes, cross-functional support is focused on regional priorities, and market learning informs Dust’s broader GTM approach. Location We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together. We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect. That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call. Why Dust The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves. We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast. If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk. Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist. Learn how we think and work. Our product constitution, a story about our mission Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human , Stanislas Polu , VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them. Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI , Gabriel Hubert , Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe. Benefits and leave administration. Run the day-to-day administration of benefits and leave across our markets. Total Rewards owns the policies, plan design, and philosophy; your team makes sure they are executed cleanly for every employee. Systems and tooling. Run the People tech stack (HiBob, Ashby, Ironclad), drive adoption, and take manual work out of the process. Process and SOPs. Design scalable, well-documented processes for every program employees touch, and keep reducing friction and cycle time. Compliance and controls. Reporting. Own people data quality and the reporting backbone that powers People analytics for the business. Deep HRIS expertise across complex, multidisciplinary system landscapes, with a strong interest in data quality, integrations, AI and tools. A track record of building and scaling lifecycle processes and SOPs internationally, and of moving work from manual to automated. Strong grasp of multi-jurisdiction employment compliance across EMEA, AMER, and APAC. Comfort operating in a tiered People model, with clear judgment on what your team owns directly and what belongs with Employee Relations, Legal, or Total Rewards. An operator's mindset: detail-obsessed, systems-thinking, and a high bar for accuracy. Comfort partnering across Finance, Legal, and IT, and communicating clearly with employees and leaders alike. Fluency in English, which is our working language. Why this role People Operations is the infrastructure that lets the rest of the People team, and the business, move fast without breaking things. That now includes building the in-market HR Generalist presence that gives every employee fast, consistent support close to home, wherever they are, with a clean handoff to Employee Relations the moment something becomes formal. You will build that infrastructure for one of the most exciting companies in tech, and set the standard for what operational excellence looks like as we scale. title: Senior Sourcing Specialist
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation About the Role This isn't a typical sourcing job. You won't be handed a list of open roles and asked to find candidates for each one. Sourcing role by role means every hire starts from nothing; we want strong people already in conversation with us before a role opens. You'll run a sourcing function of one that combines AI agents, market intelligence and an engaged talent community. That means owning three things: talent pools that are already warm, market maps that are current, and an employee referral scheme that works as a real hiring channel. You'll report to the Director of Talent and have a high level of ownership and autonomy. How you get there is for you to decide. We expect you to try new approaches, learn from what works and drop what doesn't. What You'll Do Run AI-powered sourcing: manage our sourcing agents end to end — write the briefs, review the output, tune the criteria — and judge where an agent is the right approach and where a personal one works better. Pass strong, qualified pipelines to recruiters and engage candidates directly where that adds value. Own market intelligence: build and maintain market maps and competitor intelligence for our priority hiring areas, in a form recruiters and hiring managers can use straight away. Build the talent community: grow and engage pools of people we want to hire now or in future. Run events and webinars, write a regular newsletter, and work with colleagues across Relay on blogs, vlogs and video that show what it's like to work here. Turn referrals into a real channel: drive the employee referral scheme — where it's promoted, how referrers are recognised beyond the bonus, and how fast referrals are followed up. Sit down with new joiners early to market-map the best people at their previous companies, then turn those maps into targeted outreach. Measure and adapt: track which activities lead to hires and conversations with strong candidates, and change course when something isn't working. Get ahead of problems: spot hiring problems before they're raised, propose a fix and run it. Decide which AI sourcing tools we try and adopt, and report back to the wider TA team. Who Will Thrive in This Role Proven sourcer. You've built pipelines in hard-to-hire markets, in-house or agency. AI-native in how you source. You've used AI tools hands-on in sourcing, or you pick up new tools quickly and judge their output critically. Self-starter. You can point to things you started without being asked, and what came of them. Strong writer and persuader. You write things people choose to read, and you can get a busy colleague to record a video or write a post. Equally at ease with new joiners and senior stakeholders. You build trust quickly at every level. Organised without a req list. You run several workstreams at once and set your own priorities. Measured on results, not activity. You want to define how sourcing works, not follow a fixed process. title: Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence
description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years. Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true. That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design. Partner Excellence Highlights You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls. Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it? A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training? Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring? A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning. Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science. The Opportunity As a Senior Decision Scientist, Partner Excellence at Relay, you'll: Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix. Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like. Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision. Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools. Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop. Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network. We're looking for candidates who… Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model. Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise. Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for. Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong. Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes. Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts. People-Powered Greatness : You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success. Grow the Whole Pie : You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we. title: (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager, UK
description: Change.org is looking for a (Senior) Marketing & Communications Manager to lead our organisation and team in the UK as Market Lead and be the public face of Change.org in the country. Your job is to make the country notice. You will create big, viral campaigns, online and offline, that put the everyday people who start petitions on Change.org at the centre of the national conversation. You will lead a small, high-performing team, open doors through deep networks across UK politics, civil society, civic tech, newsrooms, broadcasters, and use AI to move faster than anyone else in the news cycle. We'd welcome ambitious and entrepreneurial Communications Manager level candidates with leadership presence, who are ready to step up into a team leadership role. Change.org is the world's largest petition platform, used by more than 100 million people every year to take part in civic life and democracy. At a time when dissatisfaction with democracy is at an all-time high, we are investing heavily in AI to build the most powerful tools in the world to give people a voice, while bringing people across the political spectrum together around shared solutions. What you will achieve Create awareness spikes . Regularly turn petitions from Change.org petition starters into national moments that people talk about, through viral campaigns that combine top-tier media, social media, video, creators and offline actions such as stunts, petition handovers and public events. Turn those moments into measurable growth for Change.org in the UK, such as new petition starters, signers and supporters. At a Senior Manager level, own the UK team's goals and report on how campaigns contribute to Change.org 's wider growth targets. Put petition starters in the spotlight. Find the strongest stories and the most credible, unexpected voices, and give them the visibility they need to win. Coach them on strategy, find the route to victory, and help them build the pressure that gets decision makers to act. Earn trust across the political spectrum . Make sure Change.org campaigns speak to people across the democratic political spectrum, and protect the trust in our brand as the team moves fast with AI. At a Senior Manager level, build balance checks, transparent reporting and training into how the team works, so every campaign protects our trusted, non-partisan brand. Mobilise your network . Use and grow high-trust relationships with senior editors, producers, journalists, politicians, decision makers, civil society, civic tech and creators to secure top-tier coverage and move decision makers. Show up in person at the events, meetings and petition deliveries where those relationships are built, many of them in London and Westminster. Be our voice. Act as Change.org 's external spokesperson in the UK on TV, radio, in print and on stage, representing a trusted, open platform for people across the democratic political spectrum, including in sensitive and crisis situations. Lead a high-performing team. Set clear goals, coach and develop people, give direct feedback, and build a culture of speed, ambition and ownership where people feel supported, trusted and able to do their best work, alongside a pace that matches the news cycle. Work closely with product, data and colleagues in other markets, and contribute to global campaigns and projects. At a Senior Manager level, set team objectives, coach and develop each person on the team, and lead or shape at least one cross-functional or global project that moves a wider business goal. Lead with AI, shape the product. Build AI and agentic workflows into how the team spots stories, plans campaigns, pitches media and reports results, so the team works faster and smarter. Work closely with Change.org ’s product team as the voice of UK user groups. Test new tools and features early, feed back what works and what doesn’t, and turn launches into moments in the UK, showing petition starters how new features can help them win. What you bring A track record of viral campaigns. You have created campaigns that broke through nationally and drove measurable spikes in public attention, online and offline. You think in moments, images and headlines, and you move from idea to execution in hours, not weeks. You use performance data and testing to decide which stories to back, how to pitch them and when to change course. Fast paced. You are skilled in fast and excellent execution with rapid pivots and changing contexts. An active network. You have active and trusted networks into UK politics (including key decision makers), civil society and civic tech, across the whole democratic political spectrum, including on the left, in the centre and on the right. You bring trusted relationships with UK journalists, editors and producers. You can use your contacts to place stories and move decision makers. Management. You have led and developed a team, or have mentored others and are ready to step into leading one. You care about the people you manage and know how to build a team that’s positive, ambitious and pulls together under pressure. You’re happy rolling up your sleeves alongside them. At Senior Manager level, you have hired, managed performance and navigated team conflict, and you adapt your style to get the best from each person. Leadership presence. You are confident, credible and calm under pressure. You are confident on camera and in front of senior stakeholders, with some spokesperson experience or the appetite to build it. AI-first, curious about civic tech. You use AI tools every day and have built or improved workflows and automations with them. You know where AI adds speed and quality and where human judgement matters most, and you bring your team along. You’re excited by new tools and how people use them. You’re comfortable testing features, spotting what users need, and giving product teams clear, practical feedback. Target experience 5-8+ years in digital campaigning, political campaigns and communications or public affairs, at a campaigning organisation, charity, political party or agency. 3+ years leading people, at Senior Manager level. We're also open to candidates at Manager level who have experience mentoring others and the ambition to lead a team. A proven track record of national campaigns in the UK that created significant public attention and media coverage. Experience as an organisation's spokesperson in national broadcast and / or print media. Hands-on experience using AI in communications or campaigning work. Interested? Great! Here's what you should know This is a full-time, remote role based in the United Kingdom. Deep networks into UK politics, civil society and civic tech are core to the role, as is regular, in-person presence at events, meetings and petition deliveries, many of which happen in London. We expect up to weekly travel into London and travel costs to London are not covered by Change.org . Our compensation philosophy is based on pay equity. All of our salaries are determined before we launch a role, based on a predetermined salary scale, the level on that scale and the cost of labour for that location. The annual salary for this role at Senior Manager level is £86,000 in the UK. We are also open to candidates at the Manager level and the annual salary in the UK is £75,500. These salaries are the same wherever in the UK you live. We recognise that people assess their qualifications differently, and you may not meet every requirement listed. If you believe you could be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply. Change.org is an open platform designed to serve people across the full range of viewpoints. Effectively supporting that mission requires teams with a wide variety of experiences, skills and perspectives, which we consider essential to our work. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. We consider all applicants without regard to age, disability, gender reassignment, gender identity or expression, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. We're committed to protecting your data. To learn more, please review our Change.org Job Applicant Privacy Policy . We are committed to making reasonable adjustments for candidates throughout our recruitment process. If you need any adjustments, please let your recruiter know. title: Technical Lead (Core Services)
description: Technical Lead – Core Services Build the Future of AI in Financial Services Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We have been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors including Puma Private Equity, and commercially supported by Lloyds Banking Group and Nationwide Building Society, we previously completed one of Scotland’s largest Series A rounds. Since then, we’ve continued to grow rapidly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates, and we’re now scaling our team to meet that demand. The Opportunity We’re looking for an experienced Technical Lead to take technical ownership of the core services that underpin Aveni’s platform. This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with responsibility for the architecture, quality and operational reliability of the foundations our product teams build upon. You’ll work across areas including client-data ingestion and preprocessing, CRM integrations and APIs, multi-tenancy, identity and authentication, and data lifecycle and retention. You’ll lead the technical direction of a team of around six to seven engineers, remaining close to the code while making architectural decisions, setting engineering standards and helping other engineers grow. Our platform supports regulated financial-services organisations, so reliability, security, auditability and data isolation aren’t afterthoughts — they’re fundamental to how we design and build. What You’ll Be Doing Owning the technical architecture and direction of Aveni’s core platform services. Designing and building scalable, event-driven services on AWS. Developing and evolving our client-data ingestion capabilities, enabling new clients and data sources to be onboarded increasingly through configuration rather than bespoke engineering. Building and maintaining APIs that give Aveni products a consistent way to consume client and CRM data. Designing robust multi-tenant systems with strong data isolation, security and operational controls. Leading our approach to data lifecycle management, including retention, deletion, residency and GDPR requirements. Building resilient integrations with third-party platforms and APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, retries, reconciliation and failure recovery. Making and documenting architectural decisions and representing Core Services in Architecture Review Board discussions. Raising engineering standards across testing, observability, security, reliability and operational ownership. Remaining hands-on with production code, primarily across Node.js and AWS. Mentoring engineers through pairing, code reviews, design discussions and technical coaching. Helping the team make effective use of AI-assisted engineering tools throughout the development lifecycle while maintaining strong engineering judgement and appropriate controls. What We’re Looking For Essential Significant software engineering experience, with a strong track record of technical leadership and architectural decision-making. Deep production experience with Node.js, particularly across backend, API and distributed systems. Strong experience designing and operating cloud-native systems on AWS. Experience building event-driven architectures and an understanding of the challenges that come with asynchronous distributed systems. Experience designing production systems with complex multi-tenancy, data isolation or data lifecycle requirements. Strong experience integrating with third-party APIs and designing for rate limits, partial failures, retries and reconciliation. A strong understanding of reliability, observability, security and operational ownership. Experience making architectural trade-offs and communicating technical decisions clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders. A track record of mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards. The ability and desire to remain hands-on while providing technical direction to a team. Desirable Production experience with Python alongside Node.js. Experience with identity and access management technologies such as Auth0, AWS Cognito or similar. Strong understanding of OAuth 2.0 and authentication/authorisation patterns. Experience building software within financial services or another regulated environment. Experience handling data residency, retention and GDPR erasure requirements at scale. Experience contributing to Architecture Review Boards or similar technical governance forums. Experience establishing or improving AI-assisted software engineering practices. The Kind of Technical Lead We’re Looking For We’re not looking for someone who has moved completely away from engineering. You’ll still design systems, review code, solve difficult technical problems and contribute to production software. At the same time, you’ll create leverage by helping the engineers around you make better decisions and take greater ownership. You’ll be comfortable asking questions before reaching for a solution, thinking through failure modes as carefully as the happy path, and balancing architectural quality with the realities of delivering software in a fast-growing business. You don’t need to have used every AWS service or technology in our stack. What matters more is that you understand the underlying engineering problems, can explain the trade-offs behind your decisions, and have successfully operated the systems you’ve helped design. Benefits at Aveni What you’ll love: Remote-first working across the UK Work abroad policy Co-working spaces available 34 days holiday (including flexible bank holidays) and your birthday off Company-wide off-sites Optional Personal Development Plan Flexible benefits platform Protection essentials including Life Insurance, Income Protection, Critical Illness cover, and Pension (up to 5% matched employer contribution with optional increased contributions) Private health and dental care Potential share options Enhanced family leave Join Us in Making a Difference At Aveni, we believe that diversity drives innovation. We’ve built our business to ensure an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and its ability to drive positive change for the future of financial services, we’d love to hear from you. Even if you don’t meet 100% of requirements, we’d like to hear from you anyway if you believe you’d fit in. Apply now to join us on our mission to transform the financial services industry through AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Content Marketing Lead
description: Our Mission Human time and effort is the rarest thing in the universe. The fact that so many people hate what they do for work is a disaster on so many levels. How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About the Role As Content Lead at Dex, you'll write and publish everything that carries our name. You'll own Dex's channels: the website, social, email, our events programme and blog. You'll take a content strategy that already exists and turn it into a steady, high-quality output. This is a job for someone who writes fast and well, and who thinks past the draft. The copy is half of it. The other half is knowing where a piece needs to land, what it needs to look like to get found, and what it should do to the reader once it does. You'll work closely with Marketing, Growth, Design and Product. You'll have real autonomy and very little bureaucracy. What You'll Do Own the channels. The publishing calendar across site, social, email and the blog is yours. You decide what runs, when, and in what order. Write across every format. LinkedIn and X posts, campaign and event emails, landing pages, product and lifecycle copy, event pages and follow-ups, articles and explainers. A 90-word page and a 1,500-word argument in the same afternoon, both sounding like us. Think in distribution, not just drafts. Every piece gets planned around where it will be read: why a piece lands on Hacker News and dies on LinkedIn, which newsletters and communities our audience already trusts. Write for search and AI answers. We have a GEO and SEO spec built with our search partner: answer-first structure, extractable formatting, clean internal linking, author entity pages. You'll write to it and help us improve it. Carry the events programme. Copy and collateral for our event series, before, during and after, and the follow-up sequences that turn attendance into something. Work the numbers. Track performance and report back on the metrics that matter across our owned blog and organic social media channels. Use AI properly. Research, outlining, structuring, first passes, repurposing, quality checks. We'll give you all the Claude tokens you can use. We will not ship anything that sounds like AI wrote it, and we'll ask you how you draw that line. Guard the voice. You'll be the most frequent user of our tone of voice and audience research, and the person most responsible for whether it holds up in public. What we're looking for 4+ years writing in-house or at an agency, ideally for a technical or developer audience, ideally in a start-up where you had to build the process as well as the output Genuine range across formats and lengths, evidenced by a portfolio of published work A real view on distribution: where our audience discovers, consumes and shares things, and what a piece needs to look like to survive that journey Working knowledge of SEO and how AI search surfaces content, enough to write to a spec and challenge it Fluent with AI tools across research, outlining and iteration, with judgement about where the machine stops and you start Commercial literacy. You can connect a piece of content to an outcome and look beyond vanity metrics Editorial judgement under your own steam. You can take a rough steer and come back with something better than the brief A proactive communicator who works well without supervision and asks for what they need Nice to Have Any technical background, formal or self-taught You've run a newsletter, blog or publication of your own Experience marketing to engineers, developers or another audience that punishes fluff Experience with content for events and communities Basic design or motion skills, enough to get a social asset out without waiting What this role isn't Not a strategy job. The strategy exists and you're here to execute it, though you'll influence it constantly and we expect you to argue with it. Not a pure writing job. Publishing, sequencing, formatting, distribution and measurement are all yours. What We Offer Above market salary — we're building a world class team and believe pay should match that ambition Significant equity — we want this to be the last job you 'have' to take Full private healthcare & dental — because life happens and we want to support you Fertility benefits & enhanced parental support Gym membership & wellness benefits Claude tokens — lots and lots of Claude tokens Regular socials, offsites and an annual trip MacBook Pro + team kit "Whatever you need" approach to tools and support Interview process We move quickly and with conviction. Hiring Manager call: we'll share more specific context on short and medium-term objectives and ask deeper questions relative to the role requirements. Most roles involve a practical task to better understand how you work. Usually completed offline and reviewed by the team. Onsite interview loop where you'll visit the office, meet a cohort of the team, one interview centred on the task you produced, another on Dex culture and values, with a final interview with our Founder, Paddy.
